title: briqyard: machines and namespaces
description: Machines and namespaces across the hosts: the busiest, each one's series, restarts and drops, use per namespace.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Machines running among those selected.

panels.title: Asleep or stopped
panels.description: Machines stopped among those selected (asleep ones included).

panels.title: In error
panels.description: Machines in state error among those selected.

panels.title: In a crash loop
panels.description: Machines restarted three times or more in the last ten minutes by their restart policy.

targets.expr: count(max by (machine, name, namespace) (round(increase(briqyard_machine_restarts_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[10m]))) >= 3) or vector(0)

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: Memory the selected machines' processes hold.

panels.title: CPU in use
panels.description: Cores the selected machines use.

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: Each selected machine now: where it is, its state, what it uses.

panels.title: Top 10 by CPU
panels.description: Cores used over the last five minutes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_cpu_seconds_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top 10 by memory
panels.description: Memory their processes hold now.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_memory_bytes{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}))

panels.title: Top 10 by network
panels.description: Internet and endpoint traffic, both ways, over the last five minutes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_internet_in_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[5m]) + rate(briqyard_machine_internet_out_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[5m]) + rate(briqyard_machine_ingress_in_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[5m]) + rate(briqyard_machine_ingress_out_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores each machine uses.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_cpu_seconds_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory each machine's process holds (its cgroup: guest memory touched plus Firecracker's).

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_memory_bytes{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"})

panels.title: Memory against its size
panels.description: What it holds over its size. Above 1: Firecracker's own memory on top of a guest that touched all of its own.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_memory_bytes{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}) / sum by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_memory_limit_bytes{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"})

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: What each machine's disks, their snapshots and its memory snapshot take on the pool.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_disk_used_bytes{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"})

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes each guest read and wrote (a line a minute from Firecracker). Writes below the axis.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_disk_read_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_disk_write_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Internet traffic through the NAT and endpoint traffic through the ingress, each machine. Outbound below the axis.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_internet_in_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(briqyard_machine_ingress_in_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_internet_out_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(briqyard_machine_ingress_out_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Restarts in ten minutes
panels.description: Restarts by its restart policy over the last ten minutes. Three or more is a crash loop (red zone).

targets.expr: max by (machine, name, namespace) (round(increase(briqyard_machine_restarts_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[10m])))

panels.title: Egress drops
panels.description: Packets each machine's egress limits dropped: a blocked port, its connection rate, its bandwidth.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_egress_dropped_packets_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Disk requests held back
panels.description: Requests each machine's disk limits held back.

targets.expr: sum by (machine, name, namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_disk_throttled_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Boot time
panels.description: Each machine's last start, starting to running (a resume included).

targets.expr: max by (machine, name, namespace) (briqyard_machine_boot_seconds{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"})

panels.title: CPU per namespace
panels.description: Cores each namespace's machines use.

panels.title: Memory per namespace
panels.description: Memory each namespace's machines hold.

panels.title: Disk per namespace
panels.description: What each namespace's machines take on the pools.

panels.title: Internet per namespace
panels.description: Internet traffic of each namespace's machines, both ways.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (rate(briqyard_machine_internet_in_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(briqyard_machine_internet_out_bytes_total{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Namespaces
panels.description: Each namespace now: its machines, how many run, and what they use.

targets.expr: count by (namespace) (briqyard_machine_state{state="running", host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}) or (count by (namespace) (briqyard_machine_state{host=~"$host", namespace=~"$namespace", machine=~"$machine"}) * 0)
